title: Keep a native preview for macOS 27 screen savers
body: System Settings created the Lidscape preview with isPreview=false and a full-size frame. WebKit marked its window occluded and stopped drawing. Show a native Stockholm image while the window is occluded. Show the animated WebKit view when it is visible. macOS kept the old list thumbnail after rebuilds and a bundle ID change. A new .saver filename displayed the updated image.
author: Peter Sandström <peter@sandstre.am>

title: Use a base image for macOS screen saver previews
body: On macOS 27, the Settings preview can report isPreview=false, use a full-size virtual frame, and hide an NSImageView after Options closes even while the view reports visible. Paint the Stockholm image in the base view before WebKit starts. Use screen-sized view geometry to switch to animation. A separate full-screen host showed the animated scene; the system ScreenSaverEngine still needs visual verification.
author: Peter Sandström <peter@sandstre.am>
